description: Ministry of Defense - Determine a Place of Detention under the Prevention of Terrorism Act, 48/1979
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal order issued by the President under the Prevention of Terrorism (Temporary Provisions) Act, No. 48 of 1979. It designates a specific naval ship as a place of detention. This constitutes a regulatory matter and the exercise of powers under existing legislation, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which include statutory instruments, legal notices, and regulatory actions taken under established laws.
